title.narrative: Supporting financial service providers to use digital financial services to increase financial inclusion for MSMEs in conflict-affected areas in northern Ethiopia

description.narrative: The conflict in three northern regions of Ethiopia since 2020 has slowed economic growth and access to key services, including financial services. MSMEs have reduced operations, leading to lower employment and financial transactions. Financial Service Providers (FSPs) offer limited services and lack products suited for conflict environments. UNCDF, with development partners, aims to improve employment and economic growth in these regions by enhancing digital financial services for MSMEs and mass market users. The project focuses on improving FSPs' capacity to manage distribution networks, extend alternative credit and loan products, and increase information on digital financial services. Funded by the European Union Delegation (EUD) and supported by KFW, GIZ, and other partners, the project seeks to align with national development priorities and attract additional funding for economic recovery.
